lines.speaker: npc_tamsin
lines.text: Mind the step. Tamsin, Field Supply. Twenty years outfitting Karaveen caravans before my knees voted to stay in Ward. Packs on the wall, medkits and nano cells under the counter, and the magazine shelf by the window. Fabricators swear by it.

lines.speaker: npc_tamsin
lines.text: Back again. New issues on the shelf, fresh cells under the counter. What are we carrying today?

lines.speaker: npc_tamsin
lines.text: Digital issues from the fab co-op and the Karaveen freight houses. Download one to your slate and Brann's bench in Salvage can make what's inside. Rucksacks, frame packs, pouches, hip belts, even armour liners. Cheaper than buying, if you can scavenge the webbing.

lines.speaker: npc_tamsin
lines.text: Weight's the real limit, not room. A frame pack puts the load on your hips, so you carry more, not just stuff more in. The low tech ones you can patch yourself. The mid-tier rigs want fab alloy and servos. Every pack has sockets for pouches, and the frames take a belt or a lifter.

lines.speaker: npc_tamsin
lines.text: Medkits patch you up mid-fight; keep a few on your hotbar. The trauma kit closes worse wounds. A nano cell refills your weapon and overclocks the regulator, so the charge keeps coming back while you fire. The surge pack runs hotter and longer.

lines.speaker: npc_ossa
lines.text: The green steel cabinet under the shade canopy, next to the crates, with ARMS stencilled on the door and a cyan beacon on top. Walk up to it and press E. Press 2 to draw the pistol outside the walls; it runs on nano charge. The range is across the lane, past the barriers.

lines.speaker: npc_ossa
lines.text: Draw with 2. Left mouse fires, and so does F; hold right mouse to steady your aim. Knock down all three plates. Watch for the loose drone on the service road afterward. If you get hurt, break contact. Vitality recovers and nano refills when you stop firing.

lines.speaker: npc_ossa
lines.text: The relay knoll is west along the trail, past the waystation; two gunner droids nest on it with a worker. Their lasers walk before they fire, so move off the line and shoot the optic. The receiver is on the gunner's rack. Brann builds the rest. Train Rifle in your pack, equip it in your loadout, and draw it from your hotbar out here.

lines.speaker: npc_mira
lines.text: Morning! Flasks are fresh sealed today.

lines.speaker: npc_mira
lines.text: Afternoon. Counter's open if you need anything.

lines.speaker: npc_mira
lines.text: Evening, love. Still open, just about.

lines.speaker: npc_mira
lines.text: There you are. Need a top-up?

lines.speaker: npc_mira
lines.text: Now, where did I put the spare seals?

lines.speaker: npc_mira
lines.text: Hydroponics still owes me two crates of greens.

lines.speaker: npc_mira
lines.text: Quiet tonight. I like it quiet.

lines.speaker: npc_mira
lines.text: Not near my counter, please. Holster it.

lines.speaker: npc_mira
lines.text: Heard you came back from the Berms in one piece. Good.

lines.speaker: npc_mira
lines.text: Linn says you've taken the container on the south wall. Welcome home.

lines.speaker: npc_mira
lines.text: Word is Ossa's pleased with you. That's rare.

lines.speaker: npc_torr
lines.text: Hey. Got a spare part for me? No? Worth asking.

lines.speaker: npc_torr
lines.text: You again. Good. Something's always broken.

lines.speaker: npc_torr
lines.text: Three terminals, two spare boards. Somebody's waiting.

lines.speaker: npc_torr
lines.text: If the slab says nothing, ask a person.

lines.speaker: npc_torr
lines.text: Screens act up after dark. Always have.

lines.speaker: npc_torr
lines.text: Whoa. Wardens see that in here, you'll lose it.

lines.speaker: npc_torr
lines.text: Back from the Berms? Bring me anything with a circuit board.

lines.speaker: npc_torr
lines.text: Got yourself a roof, I hear. Keep that locker shut.

lines.speaker: npc_torr
lines.text: Another one of Ossa's orders done? Not bad.

lines.speaker: npc_vex
lines.text: Through you go. Mind the carts.

lines.speaker: npc_vex
lines.text: Gate's open. Caravans have the morning.

lines.speaker: npc_vex
lines.text: Late to be coming through. Stay where I can see you.

lines.speaker: npc_vex
lines.text: Three generations of patches on this stone.

lines.speaker: npc_vex
lines.text: Everyone gets through. Everyone helps hold the gate.

lines.speaker: npc_vex
lines.text: Weapons away inside the gate. Wardens' rule, and the Column agrees.

lines.speaker: npc_vex
lines.text: Made it back through the Berms. Plenty don't, first time.

lines.speaker: npc_vex
lines.text: Heard you've got a key now. Near enough one of us.

lines.speaker: npc_vex
lines.text: Saw you come in on Warden business. Good on you.

lines.speaker: npc_linn
lines.text: Sit a while. The shade's free.

lines.speaker: npc_linn
lines.text: Evening. Best light on the hill, this.

lines.speaker: npc_linn
lines.text: You can hear the whole market from up here.

lines.speaker: npc_linn
lines.text: This tree was old when I was young.

lines.speaker: npc_linn
lines.text: Listen. You can hear the aquifer pumps at night.

lines.speaker: npc_linn
lines.text: Not on the hill, please. Put it away.

lines.speaker: npc_linn
lines.text: You came back from the Berms. I'm glad.

lines.speaker: npc_linn
lines.text: How's the container? Keep the window shut against the dust.

lines.speaker: npc_linn
lines.text: The Wardens talk about you now. Don't let it go to your head.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: Door's open. Bring me something heavy.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: Back again? Bench is free.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: Half of this was a drone last week.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: Hoist sticks. Always the hoist.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: Easy. Holster that in my shop.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: Survived Ossa's primer, huh? Now you're useful.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: Got a locker now? Fill it with scrap. Sell me the rest.

lines.speaker: npc_brann
lines.text: Another order closed. Ossa will run you ragged.

lines.speaker: npc_tamsin
lines.text: Mind the step. Always mind the step.

lines.speaker: npc_tamsin
lines.text: Back again. Pack holding up?

lines.speaker: npc_tamsin
lines.text: Twenty years of caravan straps. My shoulders remember every one.

lines.speaker: npc_tamsin
lines.text: New issue on the shelf. The fab co-op's been busy.

lines.speaker: npc_tamsin
lines.text: Not in here, dear. Holster it.

lines.speaker: npc_tamsin
lines.text: First run in the Berms done? Your pack will want upgrading.

lines.speaker: npc_tamsin
lines.text: A home of your own. Don't fill the locker with junk.

lines.speaker: npc_tamsin
lines.text: Ossa's work again? I'll restock the medkits.

lines.speaker: npc_ossa
lines.text: The arms locker's under the canopy. Start there.

lines.speaker: npc_ossa
lines.text: Colonist. The Berms are quiet. Don't trust it.

lines.speaker: npc_ossa
lines.text: Eyes on the ridge. Always the ridge.

lines.speaker: npc_ossa
lines.text: Machines don't sleep. Neither does the watch.

lines.speaker: npc_ossa
lines.text: Weapon away inside the walls, colonist.

lines.speaker: npc_ossa
lines.text: Primer done. You'll do.

lines.speaker: npc_ossa
lines.text: Order logged. Good work out there.

lines.speaker: npc_rell
lines.text: Return lane's clear. Keep it that way.

lines.speaker: npc_rell
lines.text: Welcome back. Anything following you?

lines.speaker: npc_rell
lines.text: Dust on the wind. Could be weather. Could be drones.

lines.speaker: npc_rell
lines.text: Keep the gap clear. It's somebody's way home.

lines.speaker: npc_rell
lines.text: Holster it at the wall. Ward rules.

lines.speaker: npc_rell
lines.text: You made it through. Plates, drone, depot. Not bad.

lines.speaker: npc_rell
lines.text: Heard it on the radio. Nice work.

lines.speaker: walker_daro
lines.text: Coming through. Heavy load.

lines.speaker: walker_daro
lines.text: Caravan's in at noon, if you're buying.

lines.speaker: walker_daro
lines.text: The Tubes took the trade. Never took the road.

lines.speaker: walker_daro
lines.text: Easy, friend. I'm only carrying rope.

lines.speaker: walker_sel
lines.text: Fab's running warm today. Keep clear of the vents.

lines.speaker: walker_sel
lines.text: Mind the wand. It's calibrated.

lines.speaker: walker_sel
lines.text: Goods node's humming. Shipment due.

lines.speaker: walker_sel
lines.text: Put that away before a Warden sees it.

lines.speaker: walker_anso
lines.text: Fresh greens at the market. Tell them Anso sent you.

lines.speaker: walker_anso
lines.text: Mind the satchel. Lettuce bruises.

lines.speaker: walker_anso
lines.text: Hot one. The beans love it.

lines.speaker: walker_anso
lines.text: Whoa. Not near the greenhouses.
